description:
Check one email WITHOUT an API key: format, common typos, throwaway
    domains, role and free-provider addresses, and whether the domain has mail
    servers (MX). It never contacts the mailbox, so a good address comes back
    "unknown", not "valid"; use verify_email for a real answer. Limited per IP.
    Returns {success, credits_used: 0, result}.
name: verify_email_demo
